But I tell you, love your enemies, bless those who curse you, do good to those who hate you, and pray for those who…
Repay no one evil for evil. Respect what is honorable in the sight of all men.
Blessed is your discretion, and blessed are you, who have kept me today from blood guiltiness, and from avenging myself…

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: So David checked his men with these words, and didn’t allow them to rise against Saul. Saul rose up out of the cave, and went on his way.
translations.bsb: With these words David restrained his men, and he did not let them rise up against Saul. Then Saul left the cave and went on his way.
translations.kjv: So David stayed his servants with these words, and suffered them not to rise against Saul. But Saul rose up out of the cave, and went on his way.
translations.asv: So David checked his men with these words, and suffered them not to rise against Saul. And Saul rose up out of the cave, and went on his way.
